blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The possible speedy disposition of the plunder case of Sen. Rodante Marcoleta may possibly break the record, Ombudsman Jesus Crispin Remulla said on Friday. Remulla made this remark as Ombudsman’s special prosecutors finished presenting its evidence before the Sandiganbayan Third Division on the first day of plunder trial last week. READ: Prosecution rests case vs Marcoleta on first day of plunder trial Marcoleta was charged with plunder for accepting an alleged P75 million donation while sitting as a party-list lawmaker.
